不说话的话，就这么说定了（不说话的话，就这么说定了（第22页）“行，看来你们是默认了，往后，大家多多担待。”说完，他也转身走了。等他回到座位，四人喉间的钳制才被松开。涂山鄞大喘一口气。“这人有病吧。”玄承点头：“肯定有病，我才不会答应呢，阿洛最爱我了，肯定不会让我屈居人下。”“怎么就最爱你了？”涂山鄞直接上前，像土拨鼠打架一样掐脖，“阿洛明明最喜欢我，我和阿洛才是天造地设一对，我才是正宫。”玄承不服：“你有和她独处六十年吗？我俩若是凡人，六十年都是白头偕老了。”两人从左边推到右边，又从右边推到左边。最后，凌熠看不下去，将两人扯开。“你们都别争了，阿洛的正房，是不会要你们这种歪瓜裂枣的。”他抬起自己俊朗的脸：“我这张脸，和阿洛才是绝配。”互相掐着对方脖子的两人齐齐翻了个白眼。臭鸟，又在自恋了。裴砚清冷眼看着三只争吵，眼看三人争吵声越来越大，才冷声道：“宴席快结束了，有什么，回去再说！”三人这才注意到有人频频往这边看来，立刻停下争执。涂山鄞走到裴砚清跟前，压低声音道：“裴兄，平日我敬你，是因为沈兄太过嚣张，你是最能刺激他的，但这件事，我会争取到底。”玄承不太会放狠话，只是道：“放心吧裴兄，就算最后我做了老大，也不会像沈兄那样欺负人，我会罩着你的。”裴砚清深吸一口气，瞥向一旁的凌熠。“你又想说什么？”凌熠本来不想和这群长得没他好看的男人说话，但情敌主动提起，他不说点什么，显得他先丢了气势。“裴兄，其实你们不必在明知会输的情况下继续和我争，没意义的，我一定……”他没说完，裴砚清已经先一步拂袖冷脸离去。涂山鄞和凌熠也懒得听他那些话，留给他一个看傻子的眼神便走了。……云洛在无极宗玩了三天，静笃心血来潮，还教了她一些御兽的本事。最后，还大方地带她坐在三头蟒的头上溜了一圈。三头蟒跟云洛处熟了，还给她表演了一个将身体团成蝴蝶结。云洛看出它是在撒娇，但奈何对方外形欠妥。怕婉拒多了伤到对方小心脏，云洛以喝多了为由，连夜向静笃辞行。“阿洛，你喝多了，就别自己飞了，坐我身上吧，我保证飞得稳稳的。”一出无极宗的大门，玄承就一溜烟到了云洛跟前，摇身一变，变成一条威风凛凛的大黑龙。刚飞升的时候，他为了防着金龙族的家伙，还要处处低调。但现在不一样了，云洛是仙界最厉害的人，他可以横着走。云洛脑袋晕乎乎的，看到面前泛着金属光泽的黑鳞后，忍不住上前抱住，将脸贴在上面蹭了蹭。“还是你好看，小黑。”说完，便纵身一跃，落到了玄承硕大的龙脑袋上。“小黑，走，回家。”

If you don't speak, it's settled (If you don't speak, it's settled (Page 22) "Okay, it seems you have acquiesced. Please bear with me from now on." After saying that, he turned and left. When he returned to his seat, the clamps on the four throats were released. Tu Shan Yin took a big breath. "This man must be sick." Xuancheng nodded: "He must be sick, I won't agree to it, A Luo loves me the most, he must be my favorite. You won't let me be inferior." "Why do I love you the most?" Tu Shanyin stepped forward and strangled her like a marmot. "Aluo obviously likes me the most. Aluo and I are a match made in heaven, and I am the real one." Xuancheng refused: "Have you been alone with her for sixty years? If we were mortals, we would have grown old together in sixty years." The two pushed each other from left to right, and then from right to left. Yi couldn't stand it anymore and pulled the two away. "Don't argue. A'luo's wife won't want someone like you." He raised his handsome face and said, "My face is a perfect match for A'luo." The two of them pinched each other's necks and rolled their eyes. The stinky birds were being narcissistic again. Pei Yanqing watched the three quarreling with cold eyes. Seeing the quarrel between the three getting louder, he said coldly: "The banquet is about to end. It's over. Let's talk about it after we go back!" The three of them noticed that someone was looking over here frequently and immediately stopped arguing. Tu Shanyin walked up to Pei Yanqing and lowered his voice and said, "Brother Pei, I respect you on weekdays because Brother Shen is too arrogant and you are the most irritating to him, but in this case, I will fight to the end." If you bully people like Brother Shen, I will protect you." Pei Yanqing took a deep breath and glanced at Ling Yi. "What do you want to say?" Ling Yi didn't want to talk to these men who were not as good-looking as him, but when his love rival brought it up, he didn't say anything, which seemed like he had lost his momentum. "Brother Pei, you don't have to continue fighting with me when you know you will lose. It's pointless, I must..." He didn't finish. , Pei Yanqing had already rolled up his sleeves and left coldly. Tu Shanyin and Ling Yi didn't bother to listen to his words, leaving him with a look of fool... Yunluo spent three days in Wuji Sect, and Jingdu worked hard. Chao also taught her some beast-control skills. Finally, he generously took her to sit on the head of the three-headed python. He could see that he was acting coquettishly, but the appearance of the other party was not appropriate. Afraid of hurting the other party's heart if he refused too much, Yunluo said goodbye to Jingdu overnight, saying, "Aluo, if you drink too much, don't fly by yourself. Sit on me, I promise to fly steadily." As soon as he left the gate of Wuji Sect, Xuancheng walked up to Yunluo and transformed into a majestic black dragon. When he first ascended, he In order to guard against the guys from the Golden Dragon Clan, it was different now. Yun Luo was the most powerful person in the immortal world. He could walk sideways. When Yun Luo saw the metallic shiny black scales in front of him, he couldn't help but hug him and rub his face against it. "You look good, Xiao Hei." After that, he jumped up and landed on Xuan Cheng's huge dragon head. "Xiao Hei, let's go home."
